label: ⚠️ minqlxtended compat shim — DO NOT ENABLE separately
description: Lets plugins written for minqlx (e.g. ips.py) run unmodified on a minqlxtended-patched host by resolving `import minqlx` to the real minqlxtended module. Not a loadable plugin itself — has no minqlx.Plugin class. Only needed when the target host runs the minqlxtended-patched runtime.
